title: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property
summary: We prove the cotype–cotype conjecture under the ordinary approximation property. A nonzero real Banach space with this property is K -convex if and only if both the space and its dual have finite Rademacher cotype, possibly with different exponents.
family_title: The cotype–cotype conjecture under the approximation property

review.reason: Proves a cotype characterization of K-convexity for Banach spaces with the approximation property.
